g.title: LEG
g.text: Rectangle = entity type; diamond = relationship type; oval = attribute
= key attribute; dashed oval = derived attribute
Double line = total participation; single line = partial participation
Circle "o" = overlapping specialization; ⊂ = subclass of USER_ACCOUNT
XOR = exclusive arc (a reservation is for a booking OR a class)
Only key and main attributes shown; full list in 2_conceptual.md
